exception.justification: Justified: Private structural conversion inherits the complete public codec boundary; recording each nested field again would duplicate the same public disclosure.

review.body: { let mut fields = array_fields (v) ? ; let Some (Value :: Unsigned (tag)) = fields . next () else { return Err (Error :: Shape) ; } ; let result = match tag { 0 => Self :: PolicySelection (take (& mut fields , c) ?) , 1 => Self :: PolicyBinding , 2 => Self :: DeploymentBinding , 3 => Self :: PolicyDigest , 4 => Self :: UnsupportedPolicyRecipe , 5 => Self :: Publication (take (& mut fields , c) ?) , 6 => Self :: EvidenceBinding , 7 => Self :: SampleCoverage , 8 => Self :: Units , 9 => Self :: Bootstrap , 10 => Self :: Policy , 11 => Self :: Buffer , 12 => Self :: Verifier , 13 => Self :: RecordIdentity , 14 => Self :: HistoryPolicy , 15 => Self :: HistoryPosition , 16 => Self :: Initial , 17 => Self :: Succession , 18 => Self :: MissingLineage , 19 => Self :: RegressedLineage , 20 => Self :: Encoding , 21 => Self :: MissingOpening , 22 => Self :: AmbiguousOpening , 23 => Self :: InvalidOpening , 24 => Self :: RegressedAcceptance , 25 => Self :: OutOfLineage , 26 => Self :: InvalidMember , 27 => Self :: InconsistentAlias , _ => return Err (Error :: Shape) , } ; finish (fields) ? ; Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Explicit structural mapping preserves the listed public fields and refuses unsupported shape or bounded arithmetic. It never grants admission; the enclosing codec records the complete input and result.
